label: Definition of a cut
subgoals: Check that every input-to-node path crosses the set
Include the trivial cut of each node
Keep only cuts with at most k leaves

label: Counting cuts by merging
subgoals: Start every primary input with its trivial cut
Form all unions of one fanin cut per fanin within k leaves
Add the trivial cut and drop dominated cuts

label: How the count grows
subgoals: Bound a node's cut count by the product of its fanins' counts plus one
Count the extra cuts admitted when k grows
Relate the growth to the need for cut pruning
